claims.text: Gundahar was the head of the Bolger Family after his father, Gundolpho. He married Dina Diggle, and had two children, Adalgar and Adaldrida.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Bolger of Budgeford"
